statement.zh: Haas 等 2013 主张玉米在约 3000–1800 BCE 为饮食重要组成部分；更早文献常视晚古风玉米有限或偏仪式——「主粮」强度仍属作者解释。
statement.en: Haas et al. 2013 argue maize was dietarily important ca. 3000–1800 BCE; earlier literature often treated Late Archaic maize as limited or ceremonial—“staple” intensity remains author interpretation.

disclaimer: This record is a HYPOTHESIS / contested scholarly reading, not an established archaeological conclusion. Do not treat as fact.
